imageHeadline: Why your neck pain cycles through the day

pinTitle: Why Chronic Neck Pain Keeps Coming Back Every Day (and What Helps)
pinDescription: That persistent ache where your neck meets your traps—cycling through the day, disrupting sleep, making it hard to focus. The pattern points to mechanical causes like posture, muscle tension, and trigger points. Learn what breaks the cycle long-term, when to see a specialist, and why rest alone isn't enough.

items.label: Pain that cycles points to mechanical issues, not inflammation
Trigger points stay tense even when pain temporarily fades
Exercise therapy and posture retraining address the root cause
